review.notes: No code fences in the OCR Markdown; heading structure matches the PDF. The PDF text layer is U+200B-contaminated (74 occurrences) and also loses printed separators, so every restored footnote body was transcribed from 300-dpi renders. Line- and word-level diff of all 23 physical pages against the OCR Markdown found exactly four dropped footnote bodies (all four markers survive in the text); each was visually confirmed on a 300-dpi crop of its physical page (6, 11, 17, 21). The Table 5.B marker superscript was OCR'd as a glued 'Tasks3'; the render shows a true superscript 3. The neighboring 'Classifier hack rate environ 1/2' digits were re-checked at 300 dpi and are baseline digits, so the existing spaced form is correct. Printed page-number tokens and the table-of-contents page numbers are layout artifacts and were not restored. The Markdown uses straight apostrophes throughout (global convention); apparent missing words on pages 12/14/18/21 are en-dash/hyphen and apostrophe spelling variants present in joined form. Table 2.3.A/2.3.B/5.B values all match the PDF; the only ragged table is Table 5.B's legitimate rowspan/colspan header.
